root_cause.summary: route.exe print 0.0.0.0 output included static Persistent Routes entry (0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 26.0.0.1 9256) while Active Routes was None. Both Test-PassiveIsolation and standalone verifier previously scanned all lines without distinguishing Active from Persistent sections, falsely reporting DefaultRouteDetected=True and IsIsolated=False. Controller misidentified this disagreement as ambiguous route owner and threw unhandled BLOCKED_AMBIGUOUS_ROUTE_OWNER which exited before Step 8 receipt creation.
